answer: The fee is charged through an anchor debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the vine totals, and the dune anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 17 units per epoch, sustaining 383 aliases for 23 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
